name: Herm's Inn (Logan) Classic Buttermilk Pancakes, Eggs Benedict & Scramble
whyItWorks: Logan's favorite breakfast cottage: poached eggs over English muffins, fluffy buttermilk pancakes, and simple egg scrambles are gentle when you skip the spicy specials.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Classic Two-Egg Breakfast with sourdough toast, Buttermilk Pancakes, or classic Eggs Benedict (hollandaise on the side).
watchOuts: Hollandaise is high in egg-yolk/butter fat and a touch of lemon—request on the side
